name: Kyonyuu Princess Saimin "Gesen na Anata no Mono o... Nchu, Njurururu... Rero, Shabuttari Suru Mono Desu ka!"
original_name: 巨乳プリンセス催眠「下賤な貴方のモノを……んちゅっ、んじゅるるる……れろっ、しゃぶったりするものですか！」
source:
The throne room, despite its tranquil furnishings, was enveloped in a blazing atmosphere.
In the carpeted corridor leading from the huge doors, the women of the royal court lay in their unbecoming outfits with semen dripping from their crotches.
All of them were leaking troubled breaths, indicating that there had been a crazy party just a moment ago.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/15356]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
王座之间陈设宁静，却被炽烈气氛笼罩。
从巨大门扉通往外面的铺毯走廊上，王庭女性穿着不得体的衣服躺倒在地，精液从胯间滴落。
她们都喘着紊乱气息，说明刚才发生过一场疯狂派对。
